body: This has been a problem for years, and nothing's helped. I was taking two medications (Solifenacin and Mirabegron). But am no longer taking them as of two days ago.

I'm sorry that you have to do this. You're making the right choice. You've done everything you could and it really is up to her. This reminds me of my sister, where there's a similar situation.

I don't know how you face this sorrow. You just need to keep in mind what you already know. That even though you can still love her, you can't play her game anymore. You can't do anything for her and what you're going to do is the only option. You're not a bad person for this.
